title: Your next assessor visit in Evia
details: Milos review feedback now supplies Evia with the assessor-booked next review date already contained in the review QR
When Evia opens after a Milos review has been scanned, a five-second welcome message shows the learner's first name, current on/off-track status and next visit date
The next assessor visit date is stored locally and remains visible in the Targets section
Review status is taken from the latest Milos assessor review and displayed simply as on track or off track
No learner personal data is added to the Milos QR transfer
